The '''''Spirit of Vengeance II''''' was a large [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of [[Mandalore the Avenger]]<ref name="SoV" /> and later [[Jekiah Ordo]]<ref name="Galactic Threads">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Galactic Threads|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>.

==History==
The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] served as a Mandalorian [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] during the [[third Galactic War]], and was built in honor of the original ''[[Spirit of Vengeance]]'' shortly after its destruction during the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="SoV" />

[[File:SpiritofVengeanceII.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Spirit of Vengeance II'' attacked by the [[Hidden Chain]]]]
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> [[Jekiah Ordo]] was sent aboard the vessel by Mandalore to see if the repeated attacks against Mandalorian [[Freighter/Legends|cargo ships]] would also occur against their much larger command ship. Shortly afterwards, however, all communication with the vessel was lost as it came under [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|assault]] by the [[Hidden Chain]], a Mandalorian faction led by [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]]. In response, Mandalore, alongside [[Rass Ordo]] and the [[Alliance Commander]], rushed to the vessel's defense and fought off its assailants, who fled following their capture of the [[Clan Cadera banner|banner]] of [[Clan Cadera]].<ref name="SoV" />

[[File:Sov above Odessen.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Spirit of Vengeance II'' above Odessen]]
Following [[Malgus's escape]], Jekiah Ordo took control of the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] and used the Spirit of Vengeance to meet with the [[Eternal Alliance]] to stop Shae, Malgus, and the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="Galactic Threads" />
